capabilities.surface: Circuit Lab: NPN/PNP, N/P-MOSFET and op-amp parts
capabilities.limitations: Ebers-Moll BJT (Is = 10 fA, BR = 1) with constant CJE = 8 pF, CJC = 4 pF and TF = 0.3 ns but no voltage-dependent depletion capacitance, Early effect, reverse transit time (storage delay) or terminal resistances; SPICE level-1 MOSFET with lambda = 0.01, body tied to source and constant Cgs = 10 pF, Cgd = 2 pF instead of Meyer charges; capacitances are fixed per device type. Op-amp with 200k open-loop gain, one pole for 1 MHz GBW, symmetric smooth clipping at ±value, zero output resistance and no slew-rate limit.

Up to 8 variables; K-maps are drawn for 2 to 4 variables. The minimum cover is exact up to 40 candidate prime implicants and greedy (flagged) beyond that. Universal NAND/NOR forms are two-level realizations, not multi-level optimized.

capabilities.surface: Digital Logic Lab: Logic simulator and number codes
capabilities.limitations: Text netlists of up to 500 gates and D/T/JK flip-flops with a fixed 1 ns delay, rising-edge clocks and active-high asynchronous reset; no graphical schematic entry, buses, tri-states or setup/hold checks. Truth-table extraction supports up to 8 inputs of combinational circuits. Codes cover unsigned values up to 32 bits.

capabilities.surface: Communication: analog and digital modulation tabs
capabilities.limitations: Single-tone analog modulation with ideal analytic-signal receivers (no receiver noise or filters); digital links use ideal symbol-rate AWGN with perfect synchronization; theoretical BER for 8-PSK and 16-QAM is the nearest-neighbour approximation; eye diagrams are polar baseband without a matched filter.

capabilities.surface: Communication: sampling, PCM, line codes and error-control coding tabs
capabilities.limitations: Sine-wave PCM with mid-rise uniform or μ-law (μ = 255) quantization; line codes up to 64 bits; Hamming codes up to 57 data bits; CRC is MSB-first long division with zero initial value and no reflection; convolutional coding is the rate-1/2 K = 3 (7, 5) code with hard-decision Viterbi only.

capabilities.surface: Signals & DSP: filter designer and convolution tabs
capabilities.limitations: Butterworth and Chebyshev type I IIR up to order 12 via the prewarped bilinear transform (no elliptic, Bessel or Chebyshev II); FIR by the windowed-sinc method up to 513 taps (no Parks-McClellan); coefficients are double precision without fixed-point quantization; convolution explorer limited to 64-sample sequences.

capabilities.surface: Control: transfer function, root locus/Routh and PID tabs
capabilities.limitations: Continuous-time SISO rational transfer functions up to degree 20 without transport delay; time responses need a proper system; root locus samples gains on a logarithmic grid; Ziegler-Nichols uses the ultimate-gain method only; the PID derivative uses a first-order filter.

capabilities.surface: RF & Antennas: Smith chart, matching, transmission line, antenna array and link budget tabs
capabilities.limitations: Lossless lumped L-networks and ideal stubs at a single frequency; microstrip uses quasi-static Hammerstad-Jensen without dispersion, thickness or conductor loss; antenna arrays are uniform, collinear and ignore mutual coupling; link budgets are free-space Friis without terrain, multipath or rain models.

Ideal formulas: 555 thresholds at exactly 1/3 and 2/3 Vcc, op-amps with a single-pole GBW and rail-to-rail output, E48/E96 values generated by rounding (E192 not included), capacitor codes cover the common three-digit EIA marking only.

capabilities.surface: Microcontroller Lab: 8051 assembler, simulator, trainer board and serial terminal
capabilities.limitations: 8051/8052-style core with 128 B direct + 256 B indirect RAM, timers 0/1 and UART; no timer 2, power-down/idle modes or on-chip variants (e.g. AT89S52 watchdog). UART TI timing follows the datasheet (start of stop bit) and differs from ucsim by under 1 %. The LCD model ignores controller busy time; keypad and switches have no bounce.

Fixed-step trapezoidal integration (backward Euler on the first step) limited to 20,000 points; one independent source follows a step, sine, square-pulse or constant stimulus while the others stay at DC. Switches keep their authored state; no adaptive time step, breakpoints or diode junction capacitance.
Small-signal sweep linearized at the DC operating point with a 1 V or 1 A input on one source; logarithmic sweep limited to 1,000 points. No noise, distortion or pole-zero analysis.
